notes.title: Game Balancing and Various Adjustments
notes.content:
Hello, fellow survivors!

I've heard your feedback and have implemented some exciting changes to enhance your gaming experience:

[list]
[*] [b]Increased Experience Gain:[/b] You will now earn more experience points, especially during the first few levels, to help you progress faster.
[*] [b]Larger Pickup Area:[/b] The area in which you can collect experience has been expanded, making it easier to gather.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] We've fixed a game-breaking bug related to the drone upgrade to ensure smoother gameplay.
[*] [b]Balanced Enemy Spawning:[/b] Enemy spawning patterns have been adjusted for better balance, providing a more challenging yet fair experience.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923703/399563c7c02887e7c75b5ac7c0826126ed8addc4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923703/0e790ebbea851578241adf173edd44cd46df0fc3.png[/img]

That's it for now. Keep playing and let the fight for survival begin!
